description: Firebase credentials for pushing Frappe notifications to the mobile app.

fields.description: While this is off, nothing is queued and nothing is sent. The app falls back to what it did before: notifications appear only while it is open.
fields.label: Send Push Notifications

fields.options:
In the Firebase console, open Project settings → Service accounts and choose Generate new private key. Paste the whole downloaded file below.

This key can send a notification to every device in the project. Anyone who can read this field holds it, which is why only System Manager can. To keep it out of the database entirely, leave the field blank and set mobile_push_service_account in site_config.json instead — the site config wins over this field when both are present.

fields.description: The whole JSON key file, pasted as it was downloaded.
fields.label: Service Account JSON

fields.options: Sign in on the mobile app first, allow notifications when it asks, then use Send Test Notification above. It reports each of your registered devices separately with Firebase's own error message, so a setup that is not working says which part of it is wrong.

name: Mobile Push Settings
